04.01.2023 AO No.386 of 2022
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
Present Proposed Appeal has been 
filed under Section 30 of the Employee’s 
Compensation Act, 1923 along with an 
application to condone the delay of 11 days 
in preferring the proposed appeal.
Heard Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned 
counsel for the proposed appellants and Mr. 
Anil Kumar Joshi, learned counsel for the 
respondent on the Delay Condonation 
Application (IA No.2 of 2022). 
The Delay Condonation Application is 
not opposed by the respondent. 
In the interest of justice, Delay 
Condonation Application (IA No.2 of 2022) 
is allowed. Delay of 11 days in preferring 
the proposed appeal is condoned. 
List this case on 20.02.2023 for 
arguments on Admission.
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.)
